items: 【Size and Package Included】 Our Plant support stakes are 16 inch long. Inner diameter of the top loop is about 2.4 inch and open slot is about 0.6 inch. Our diameter of wire is 4.0 mm, which is more stable, not easy to fall off. Each package contains 12pcs plant stakes and 24pcs twist ties.

【Durable & Stable】 FEED GARDEN flower stakes and supports are made from premium solid steel with a green powder-coated finish. They are not easy to bend and fade, provide firm support for stem plants. The dark green color blends with your plants, offering a natural and beautiful look.

【Help Plant Grow Uprightly】Our plant props support can effectively to prop up stem plant to grow straightly and healthily, prevent stems from bending and entangling with each other, support flowers and leaves growing, avoid to fall and break off, well protect the single stem plants without causing restriction to growth.

【Widely Used】 Our plant sticks support fits for most outdoor and indoor flowers and the plants with single stem, like rose, orchid, narcissus, sunflower, peony, lily, tomato seedlings, amaryllis, gladiolus, pepper, zinnia, etc.

【About Us】 FEED GARDEN provides quality products and efficient after-sales service. If you're not satisfied with our garden support stakes, please contact us, we will provide you with a solution as soon as possible.
